verdict.rationale: Brex documents AI-powered automation and an MCP server (agentic/API access), suggesting natural-language operation is plausible, but a hands-on community account of Brex's own natural-language expense bot demo found factual errors (wrong date on receipts) and engineers voicing concern about non-deterministic/hallucinating output for production financial use — a concrete documented failure of the natural-language capability. Missing for 10: reliable first-party demonstration of accurate NL command execution, independent corroboration that the bot/MCP interface works correctly in practice.
